notes.title: CCD&B version 2.0 is here!
notes.notes:
CCD&B has been upgraded to a better engine (RPG Maker MV)!

So what does that mean?
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25861886/e52a35df8957f4ec77bc4b831bb9cc8dbc1242ae.png
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25861886/6b04cfba355235406ff8538f5f5885f58d9a6b12.png
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25861886/8aaeec68f611cbf0d10bfbeb928348b6210cbeb1.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25861886/e4b1934bec3806df2ff660eac22a25deafcc19e8.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25861886/a2dfef649a505c8ecc992727dd710e23308f33f3.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25861886/a2e76f4b1c4b42506104f36083554ec2f83d7e07.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25861886/4b69a0d28992d8107285f8a36bf660c8368f366a.png

You can now add Hermina Lumen is Only Human to your wishlist!
Enjoyed CCD&B? The sister game starring Hermina, Hermina Lumen is Only Human, is in the works! You can now add it to your Steam wishlist here.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25861886/7a514d5c3f64b228a8298257274ed366dbfe70a4.png

"Hey, wait! I was in the middle of a playthrough on 1.0!"
No worries— when you launch the game, it'll let you choose between 1.0 or 2.0. Please note that the option to launch 1.0 will be deprecated on 08/10/19. For reference, one run of the game averages about 2 hours.

Bug Reports
If you encounter any issues in 2.0, please feel free to shout it by either emailing me at support @ badchalk.com or by making a post on the Discussion board.
